ai_review.summary: Intact Good Lovin' performance retained and Mickey’s drum solo left untouched in a well‑preserved recording
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the decision to keep “Good Lovin’” whole, noting it avoids the common practice of splitting out a drum solo as its own track—a nod to Mickey’s indulgent moments from later decades. While no specific sound quality comments are given, the 5‑star rating suggests the recording meets listeners’ expectations.
